It offers large three-bedroom homes from roughly 2,100 sq ft, a deep sports-and-club lifestyle program, and proximity to key corridors—positioned for end-users who value space, access, and community amenities.
who_is_it_for: If you’re seeking a sizable, future-ready home close to the Dwarka Expressway, this launch fits well. The project focuses on large-format three-bedroom layouts (from about 2,100 sq ft) that suit growing families needing an extra study, lounge, or hobby corner. Daily wellness is well-covered—think a full gym, pools (including a kids’ pool and an indoor option), courts for badminton, tennis, and squash, plus yoga lawns and a jogging/cycle track. Parents get children’s play areas and a reading room, while multi-generational households benefit from a senior citizens’ zone and spa/sauna access. Being in the 102 precinct near the expressway equally helps professionals who split time between Delhi and Gurugram’s office clusters. Early movers typically benefit from first choice on stacks and club adjacency during new launches, while the single-typology focus simplifies decision-making for buyers who want a straightforward planning journey. The location and amenity mix, along with current public filings naming BPTP as promoter, make it a pragmatic choice for families prioritising access, scale, and on-site lifestyle [5][8].
location_connectivity: The address sits just off the Dwarka Expressway, giving quick access to Delhi-bound and Gurugram corridors. It also links out toward Pataudi Road for west–southwest connectivity. Daily commutes, airport runs, and cross-city errands are simplified by the project’s edge-of-corridor siting, with the 102 micro-market steadily densifying around the expressway spine [5].
